citations.claim: cart exceeded -2.4 m track limit at first violating step
cart was already drifting steadily negative shortly before violation
drift accumulated over long run from near origin

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.0053669569231086147 to 0 with all else identical; drift disappears and no cart_in_track violation in 374 steps, showing noise-driven position bias caused the track exit.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes and controller force ~0.7 far below 51.86 limit, with pole nearly upright (theta=-0.08, margin 0.72) at violation. Cart velocity stays sustained negative (-0.8 at step 300 to -1.37 at step 374), integrating small initial offset x=-0.095 into steady drift off the -2.4 m end. Removing only sensor_noise eliminates the failure, indicating the state-feedback controller under seeded measurement noise prioritizes pole balance while allowing position bias to integrate into track exit.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.405 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart is at the far left end of the track with the pole still nearly upright. From step 371 to 374 it creeps further left with no pole fall or sudden motion.
